_comment: HydroPro, native emtk window. The parameter panels are read from hydropro.view.json (the Qt AutoForm spec: one source for labels, limits, steps and descriptions) and only given spin arrows and a fold; this file holds what the Qt tool built by hand around them: the file and run buttons, the results table, the output pane. Drawn by emtk.view_form over gui/model.py.

input_buttons.description: Choose the structures and the HYDRO program.

buttons.label: Select files…
buttons.description: Pick one or more structure files (PDB or bead coordinates) with the file chooser; they replace the list in 'Structures'.

buttons.label: Executable…
buttons.description: Pick the HYDROPRO or HYDRO++ program with the file chooser.

buttons.label: Download page
buttons.description: Open the HYDRO++ / HYDROPRO download page in your web browser. The program is a separate download and is not part of ChiSurf.

results.description: Run the program over the listed structures; save or clear the results.

buttons.label: Run
buttons.description: Run HYDROPRO / HYDRO++ once per listed structure. The parameters are checked first; the output pane shows the program's console while it runs.

buttons.label: Save CSV
buttons.description: Write the results (file and diffusion coefficient in cm²/s) to a CSV file. Available once a run has finished.

buttons.label: Clear
buttons.description: Empty the structure list, the status and the results.

results.description: One row per listed structure with its translational diffusion coefficient in cm²/s once a run has finished (N/A when the program's report holds none). Click a header to sort.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The structure file as listed in 'Structures'.

columns.title: Diffusion coefficient (cm²/s)
columns.tooltip: Translational diffusion coefficient D_t parsed from the program's report; empty before a run, N/A when the report has none.

output.description: How many of the structures of the run are done.
What the run is doing: Ready, Starting, Cancelling, Finished or Failed.
The program's console output and the job messages of the run; select with the mouse and copy with Ctrl+C.
Manage the output log or stop the run.

buttons.label: Clear log
buttons.description: Empty the output log (the results table is not touched).

buttons.label: Save Log…
buttons.description: Write the output log to a text file.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Stop after the structure that is being computed has finished; the structures not yet started are skipped.
